verdicts.reason: A keeps the product can (with its circle) at the right, the logo at top centre and a sensible quote-then-attribution order, but the quote mark floats far above the quote line, the quote text is small for a banner, and the left half is mostly empty. B blows the attribution up to nearly the quote's size, so the two compete for attention. It also shrinks the product and logo to tiny, illegible specks at the bottom, leaves the right circle empty, and runs the quote line almost to the edge of the canvas.
